script code

  • CURIE: gmeow:scriptCode
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/scriptCode
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/languages

The ISO 15924 script code of a writing system ("Latn", "Hani", "Hira", "Kana", "Arab", "Brai") when one exists, else a bespoke identifier for a conlang/AI script with no registered code. The bridge for names' gmeow:nameScript literals to resolve to a first-class WritingSystem. Non-functional.

Structure

Property shape: datatype property; gmeow:WritingSystem -> rdfs:Literal

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:scriptCode from gmeow:WritingSystem to rdfs:Literal when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
